{{Quote|The pupil known as Dustil has shown remarkable progress. His talent with the Force is great. The same, however, cannot be said for the human female that he arrived with, Selene.<br /><br />She has little talent. Moreover, Dustil holds a great degree of affection for her. This is a weakness in the boy and has been slowing down his training.<br /><br />Orders were sent this morning to have the girl removed from the academy and terminated. I will tell Dustil that she was killed in the valley. He will forget her soon enough, I think&hellip; he is too promising to lose at this juncture.|An entry in the datapad|<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''datapad''' belonging to the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Uthar Wynn]], the Headmaster of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], contained numerous entries of notes by Wynn. When [[Carth Onasi]] was trying to persuade his [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|corrupted]] son, [[Dustil Onasi|Dustil]], that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were evil, Dustil wanted proof. Carth and the redeemed [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] broke into Wynn's room and found this datapad. Carth gave it to Dustil, who saw the truth and left the Sith.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Uthar Wynn's datapad was an item featured in the [[2003]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.
